Question 2
?

The 10th and 11th terms of an arithmetic sequence are 30 and 33, respectively. Determine the formula for the nth term of the sequence.

a
 an=2n+5
b
 an=2n−4
c
 an=3n+3
d
 an=3n
e
 an=4n+2
